4. No signed-in user sees a raw key, including after a reload and on the first render after sign-in.

Responsibility: `objectui Console: the sign-in page fetches /i18n anonymously, and nothing re-loads the application's translations with the session's credentials | the Console's I18nProvider loaders and its session state already on main | every Console user at sign-in, once objectstack-ai/objectstack#22432 refuses an anonymous /i18n read`
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR and no in-flight claim touches `apps/console/src/main.tsx`, `loadLanguage.ts` or `loadLocales.ts` (read 2026-10-09T07:29Z).
